messages.subject: Project Mallory — signed and exchanged
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The Amendment and Restatement Agreement was signed and exchanged this afternoon. Final agreed terms: new £6m super-senior Facility C; margin uplift of 185bps to 4.35% on Facility A and the RCF; amendment fee 0.85% (£357,000) plus the £120,000 Facility C arrangement fee; and the reset covenants stepping from 5.00x (Mar-26) to 3.50x (Mar-27). The Effective Date will occur on 28 February once the £2m equity is received and the funds flow settles. Congratulations to everyone — a good outcome.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0021
